scenarios.name: default reset unstages all staged edits
scenarios.expected_effect: main stays at C; both edits remain in the worktree and are unstaged

scenarios.name: path reset unstages only the selected path
scenarios.expected_effect: main stays at C; notes.txt is unstaged and todo.txt remains staged

scenarios.name: hard reset moves main to B and restores its tree
scenarios.expected_effect: main moves from C to B; todo.txt is removed and notes.txt is restored
